name: Keot
source: No one really knows why Keot decided to settle in Ethger, but one thing is for sure: his life is not easy, and not just due to his blindness. There are many bad rumors circulating around dark mages from Hizaran in these lands, so Keot constantly faces distrust and contempt from the locals. Despite that, his knowledge might turn out to be rather crucial regarding the current issues in the city...
